text:
andrew: Heads up — after the maintenance window this morning we've got OOB auth failures on a subset of GPU racks in ap-southeast1. BMC consoles reject the existing SSH keys and provisioning jobs start failing (~06:12 UTC).
jen: which racks specifically?
sasha: saw a spike in failed PXE handoffs on our dashboards too.
andrew: racks: gpu-rack-14, gpu-rack-15 (10 nodes each). oncall bot flagged >40% provisioning errors for that hostgroup.
oncall-bot: [alert] oob-auth-failure detected on gpu-rack-14 (10 nodes), service: oob-console, severity: warning
lucas: is this from the firmware roll? we rolled 2.7.3 -> 2.7.5 last night, right?
andrew: yes. Preliminary grep of racadm logs shows a change in accepted key-hash policy after the upgrade — looks like the allowed-key-hash list got cleared on those BMCs.
sasha: that explains the console bounce. Can we re-add the keys remotely?
lucas: trying ipmitool now from jump-ops.
lucas: ```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.70.14.3 -U admin -P <redacted> user list
ID  Name       Callin  Link Auth  Priv  Password
1   admin      true    false      4     true
2   ops        false   false      3     false
```
andrew: exact output for a affected node. user table still there but ssh-key auth appears disabled.
jem: FYI this coincides with the reserved-capacity run for gpu-provisioning at 07:00 UTC. If we start mass-key actions we may race with live bootstrap jobs.
lucas: plan: create temporary local user and push a consolidated authorized_keys entry via racadm for the ten nodes, then re-enable key auth and rotate. I'll do a canary on 3 nodes first.
sasha: can we divert new provisioning to eu-west-2 while we patch? that region has spare capacity and is in the route-fallback set.
andrew: we can set queue routing for "gpu-provision" to region-fallback=eu-west-2, but tenant constraints for some customers block non-AP regions. we'll need an exception list.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot triggered: canary-deploy (oob-key-roll) -> targets: gpu-rack-14:{node01,node02,node03}
deploy-bot: status: in_progress
lucas: running key push script now (dry-run for node01).
lucas: ```
#!/bin/bash
for ip in 10.70.14.1 10.70.14.2 10.70.14.3; do
  racadm -r $ip -u root -p $PASS sshcfg set authMethod=publickey
  racadm -r $ip -u root -p $PASS sshcfg set authorizedKeys="ssh-rsa AAAA... ops-key"
done
```
jen: keep output in the incident channel and annotate any nodes that fail. I don't want half the rack getting reboots unexpectedly. :eyes:
andrew: agreed. runbook below — short checklist for the rollout:
1) Canary push to node01-03 (oob key add only)
2) Verify provisioning for canary nodes (PXE + cloud-init)
3) If green, escalate to rack-level in 10-node batches
4) After rack-level success, rotate keys and re-enable old-key blacklist
5) Open ticket with vendor for firmware diff and request hotfix

sasha: vendor ticket sounds right. put firmware logs and racadm diffs in the ticket.
jem: routing note: i've scheduled a temporary policy to divert non-EU tenants to eu-west-2 until 09:00 UTC. will monitor costs — cross-region provisioning spikes billing.
andrew: cost note acknowledged. keep finance in the loop if >$5k delta.
oncall-bot: [update] canary node01: key push succeeded, provisioning test passed (cloud-init completed).
deploy-bot: canary progress: 1/3 succeeded, 2/3 queued.
lucas: node02 failed to accept the authorizedKeys entry (racadm returned 500 - internal), collecting logs.
andrew: mark node02 DO NOT PROVISION and remove from autoscaler groups to avoid retries.
sasha: adding temporary healthcheck rule to fail fast so the autoscaler doesn't requeue.
jen: nice work. who owns follow-up vendor ticket? andrew?
andrew: i'll own the vendor ticket and paste the diffs. lucas will handle the mass script once we get vendor guidance. action items in thread footer. :thumbsup:

---
ACTION ITEMS:
- andrew: open vendor support ticket with racadm and firmware diffs (done: ticket #INC-8421)
- lucas: collect racadm error logs from node02 and prepare mass key push script (in progress)
- jem: monitor cross-region costs and update finance if >$5k delta
- sasha: add healthcheck rule to prevent autoscaler retries (done)
- jen: coordinate reserved-capacity schedule adjustments with customers (pending)

andrew: I'll post a short postmortem once vendor confirms root cause. Thanks all.
